cases.name: Exchange a pair

cases.name: Activation outside combat

cases.name: Copy an optional target with a mechanic
cases.text: This creature becomes a copy of up to one target nonlegendary creature you control until end of turn, except it has myriad.

cases.name: Copy with a numbered mechanic

cases.name: Two independent exchange groups

cases.name: Exchange inside a granted activation

cases.name: Copy with a ward payment
